narratives.body: Bradley Beal has been ruled out for upcoming games against the Lakers and Sacramento due to a knee injury. NBC Sports reported on October 21 that Beal is out versus Sacramento, and on October 23 confirmed he remains unavailable against the Lakers. This absence follows a recent development where the Clippers indicated that Chris Paul's former jersey number, No. 3, will be retired in Beal's honor.
narratives.headline: Bradley Beal ruled out for Lakers and Sacramento games due to knee injury.
